preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 10.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= N <= 10000 for N in N_list)

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(result, int) for result in results)
all(0 <= result for result in results)

all(result == max(sum(cnt_i * b for S_i, b in S_b_list) for A_s in substrings(A) for B_s in substrings(B) for cnt_i in [count_substrings(A_s + B_s, S_i) for S_i, _ in S_b_list]) for result, A, B, S_b_list in zip(results, A_list, B_list, S_b_list_list))
postconditions.description: Each result is the maximum possible pleasure Chef can get from a string C formed by concatenating any substrings A_s of A and B_s of B.
